39:t_1:86.en:
$$甲児$$
「But according to what $$ブルー$$ said, there seem to be people there who'll lend us their strength.」

39:t_1:87.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's waiting for us is a surprise we'll find out when we get there. Right, $n?」

39:t_1:90.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you still worrying about $$シンジ$$...?」

39:t_1:92.en:
$n
「A $$時空震動$$ or a dimensional quake hits, and someone who was with us until yesterday suddenly disappears... How long is this going to keep happening...」

39:t_1:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ people are missing, but I'm sure they're not dead. We'll see each other again someday.」

39:t_1:96.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$ is right. So that we can meet again with smiles on our faces, let's first think about driving the $$サイデリアル$$ off Earth.」

39:t_1:98.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n's father and sister were caught up in a dimensional quake and lost their lives...)

39:t_1:99.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The one who caused that dimensional quake... 《$$テンシ$$》... We defeated 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, the mastermind of the $$時獄戦役$$, but the 《$$血塗られた眼$$》 didn't disappear...)

39:t_1:100.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Those symptoms show up when $$テンシ$$ is nearby... If so, then $n's fight is...)

39:t_1:101.en:
$$正太郎$$
「After $n, now Miss $$スズネ$$ is spacing out.」

39:t_1:102.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Huh... Oh... Well... I was thinking up excuses to give the school for the Volunteer Club members' absence during this operation...」

39:t_1:103.en:
$$さやか$$
「Thank you for your hard work, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

39:t_1:104.en:
$$宗介$$
「I apologize for the trouble, but I leave it to you.」

39:t_1:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Leave it to me. After all, everyone's promotion to the next grade is at stake.」

39:t_1:108.en:
$n
「Well then, Club President... Give us the usual call.」

39:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「Volunteer Club president to all members! Our mission for the time being is cleaning and tidying up this ship!」

39:t_1:110.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what's waiting for us on $$翠の地球$$, but a messy living space means a messy mind! Let's get it done quickly!」

39:t_1:114.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know. They won't let us advance easily.」

39:t_2:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! At this rate the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will burn up from friction with the atmosphere!」

39:t_2:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「After the transformation, we go to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ at maximum acceleration and push its hull up.」

39:t_2:8.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's reckless! If we do that, the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ will burn up first!」

39:t_2:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There's a lot of debris around. ...$$ボビー$$, transfer the helm to me.」

39:t_2:10.en:
$$ボビー$$
「OK, Boss! You're really going to do it, aren't you - your ace in the hole!」

39:t_2:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$フォーメーション・ビッグウェンズデー$$! Here we go!!」

39:t_2:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Look, look, $$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$! Shooting stars!」

39:t_2:18.en:
$$メルティ$$
「But aren't there kind of too many?」

39:t_2:19.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Don't worry about it, don't worry about it. It's perfect for making a wish anyway.」

39:t_2:21.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$ベベル$$ heard from Mr. $$オルダム$$ that if you make a wish on a shooting star, it comes true.」

39:t_2:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Honestly... that's all you ever think about, $$メルティ$$.」

39:t_2:24.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「What are you going to wish for, $$エイミー$$?」

39:t_2:26.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Maybe... 'May tomorrow be a good day, too.'」

39:t_2:28.en:
$$エイミー$$
「May tomorrow be a good day, too...!」

39:t_10:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you okay, $$ＡＧ$$? The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ was shaking like crazy.」

39:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is no problem at all. We got through it safely thanks to a rescue by $$ジェフリー$$'s transcendent riding.」

39:t_10:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't really get it, but as long as everyone's safe, that's fine.」

39:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, thanks to $$かなめ$$ giving $$アル$$ a lecture on how to handle $$宗介$$, it seems the effect showed up right away.」

39:t_10:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ha ha... and we were only making small talk, too.」

39:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... The extent of the effect shows in the $$Ｚチップ$$.」

39:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 50 Z. It's nothing much for now, but believing it will bear great fruit someday, I'll add it to the stock.」

39:t_10:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ told me about it, but you really do love $$Ｚチップ$$, huh.」

39:t_10:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you don't mind, will you show me the real thing?」

39:t_10:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Beautiful... It's like my consciousness is about to be sucked in...」

39:t_10:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine. I just had a little headache.」

39:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If that's all, then fine... But if anything happened to $$かなめ$$, I wouldn't be able to face $$宗介$$ either.」

39:t_10:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're making too big a deal of it, $$ＡＧ$$.」

39:t_10:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah. I've heard how it goes from $$アルト$$ and the others.」

39:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here I go! Let's give it our all again today...」

39:t_10:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Business, business! And just for good measure, big business!」

39:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for the big service. As expected of a 《$$ウィスパード$$》.」

39:t_10:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... How do you know that...!」

39:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hee hee... well, never you mind that. Don't underestimate a dimensional merchant's information network.」

39:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right... your existence will greatly influence what happens from here on...)

39:t_10:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you okay, $$ＡＧ$$? The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ was shaking like crazy.」

39:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is no problem at all. We got through it safely thanks to a rescue by $$ジェフリー$$'s transcendent riding.」
